SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM satscores_ext s
JOIN schools_ext sch ON s.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 400 AND sch.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT DISTINCT f.CDSCode
FROM frpm_core f
JOIN frpm_ext fe ON f.CDSCode = fe.CDSCode
WHERE fe.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 500;

SELECT 
    MAX(fepct) AS HighestEligibleFreeRate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        frpm_ext.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)` AS fepct
    FROM 
        frpm_core
    INNER JOIN 
        frpm_ext ON frpm_core.CDSCode = frpm_ext.CDSCode
    INNER JOIN 
        satscores_ext ON frpm_core.CDSCode = satscores_ext.cds
    WHERE 
        (satscores_ext.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores_ext.NumTstTakr) > 0.3
) subquery;
